rotation: q(R) of each state scaled by rho (Le Roy; as the 2008 model's alpha)

isotope_shift.form: dV_B(R) = (1 - y)^p (a0 + a1 y), y = (R - Re_B)/(R + Re_B), cm-1 per unit (1 - rho), rho = mu(127I2)/mu; added to the B potential (X is the reference); vanishes towards the separated atoms
isotope_shift.selected_by: leave-one-line-out rms over the seven training lines (a training objective)
isotope_shift.source: CIPM isotope-shift intervals of bipm2003a (633 nm) and bipm2003d (532 nm), each component tied to a measured 127I2 frequency; the pending sets of the same lines stay blind
isotope_shift.joint_note: Cholesky factor of the covariance of (the fit's 86 whitened parameters, a0, a1) given the seven CIPM isotopologue lines, each with sigma (+) 0.1 MHz; the shift's marginal covariance is its last 2 x 2 block

nuclear_ratios.source: Salumbides et al., Mol. Phys. 104, 2641 (2006), Table 1

hyperfine.status: 127I2 functions scaled per nucleus, tested on the CIPM 129I2 and 127I129I patterns (v' 6-14)
hyperfine.rule: per nucleus: eqQ x Q ratio, C x g ratio, d and delta x g_1 g_2; B in the core: the core fit's radial functions over the isotopologue's wavefunction; X in the core: the fixed formulae at the 127I2-equivalent u, x = rho J(J+1) and energy; beyond the core: the 127I2 constants interpolated at the equivalent (v, J); 127I2's B v' 77/78 1g resonance is not carried over

j_rule: levels above J = j_split are solved on the long grid with the barrier rule; constants beyond the hyperfine tables' last J are held at it; a level's model sigma grows as J(J+1)/(J_r(J_r+1)) beyond J_r, the J the training rows reach at its v or within 2 in v, plus 15 (a rule, not fitted)
equivalents: an isotopologue level's 127I2 equivalent: the fractional v of the same J = 0 energy, and J with J(J+1) scaled by rho; the frozen uncertainty tables are read at the nearest integer level
